title: Repeats and bar marks on a tab staff
description: Every bar-owned mark a tab reader is owed, on a tab-opting part: a forward repeat with cut time on bar 1, a first ending closed by a backward repeat played three times (the 3x over the barline), an open second ending, a final barline, and a dynamic (mf, then f) and a direction (Swing) at the columns the notation staff puts them at. Pins the standalone tab staff's repeats, voltas, cut-time symbol, dynamics and directions — before core-measure-attributes-gaps.md item 5 the standalone tab view drew a plain barline where the document said repeat and nothing at all for the rest (the both view already had repeat dots and one volta because the notation layout drew them).
